summary: Preserve the inner-only name of a named class expression when lowering a non-escaping class expression.

target.notes: Generate one C# type and rewrite references to the named-expression binding inside the class body to that type. Do not expose the inner name outside the expression scope.

caveats: The named class expression binding has JavaScript lexical semantics and is not a C# namespace/type alias visible outside the expression.

tests.name: internal self reference
tests.input: const C = class Inner { static make() { return new Inner(); } }; console.log(C.make() instanceof C);
tests.expected_csharp: private sealed class __J2csClass0 { public static __J2csClass0 make() => new __J2csClass0(); }

tests.name: edge: inner name not visible outside
tests.input: const C = class Inner {}; console.log(typeof Inner);
tests.expected_behavior: prints undefined (or throws if directly referenced as an unbound identifier in another expression context); the generated inner name must not leak
